summary: Focused frontend retest completed against the public URL. All four reported fixes passed: live-room actions now show confirmation toasts and chat clears; informational footer buttons show demo-only feedback while all Platform links route correctly; the mobile Sheet is accessible and error-free at 390px/430px; and Home plus /live show the four August 2026 dates. Light regressions for search, reservation states, Aviation routing, theme switching, and route console errors also passed. Production build compiled successfully.
seed_data_creation: No backend data created. Browser localStorage key 'experia-reservations' was cleared before the reservation regression test; the test then created one local mock reservation. Theme localStorage was toggled during regression testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 was intentionally limited to the four fixed issues plus the requested light regression. Verified representative Company/Support/Legal footer buttons and all six Platform footer routes. Mobile checks at 390px and 430px found no Radix DialogTitle/DialogDescription or other console errors. Home, /live, and /conversations/inside-indian-aviation emitted no console errors during tested flows.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously dead controls now call Sonner toasts and the chat submit handler clears controlled state; placeholder informational footer links are buttons with demo feedback while Platform entries remain React Router links; SheetTitle and SheetDescription satisfy Radix accessibility requirements; UPCOMING mock data now uses weekday-consistent August 2026 dates. All fixes were reproduced as working on the public deployment.
